artifacts.notes: 148 of 148 pages in the provider roster: PP 1–PP 12, PA 1–PA 132, PT 1–PT 4. Provider PA 77–PA 80 precede PA 73–PA 76. No missing or failed roster IDs. Physical-volume completeness is unverified. Title and stated boundary images were inspected; acquisition and structural integrity do not imply full textual reading. No OCR or transcription is included. Original .jpg filenames may contain PNG bytes, identified explicitly in sequence.json. Google digitizer attribution is retained on the image feet; no additional Google front-matter page is inserted or counted as part of the historical work. The package is a deterministic project assembly of exact acquired image bytes, not a provider-supplied ZIP. Each image remains byte-identical to acquisition; ZIP_STORED is used and every member has a SHA-256 in sequence.json. All 332 retained source images passed declared byte-size and SHA-256 verification. Independent Poppler extraction recovered 251 JPEG streams byte-identically and 81 PNG images with decoded pixels identical to their exact originals across the three PDF derivatives; artifact page counts matched 148,96 and 88.
